source_title: Magic: The Gathering — Wilds of Eldraine
continuity_scope: Bound to Magic: The Gathering's Wilds of Eldraine main set (set code WOE), released September 8, 2023, and its official five-part English Magic Story released August 8-14, 2023. This is one set-story moment on the plane Eldraine after the Phyrexian invasion, not a franchise-wide Magic, plane-wide, or all-card audit. WOC Commander and WOT Enchanting Tales have separate set codes and are treated only as gameplay/product distinctions, not story continuities.
work_or_witnesses: Wilds of Eldraine, WOE, Wizards of the Coast, September 8, 2023
Wilds of Eldraine official Magic Story, Episodes 1-5, August 8-14, 2023
A First Look at Wilds of Eldraine, Wizards of the Coast, July 28, 2023
coverage_rule: Include every named dramatic individual directly profiled in the official 'The Characters of Wilds of Eldraine' section of the selected set announcement and materially situated in the five-part story: Talion, Ashiok, Kellan, Will, and Rowan. Treat card names, creature types, colors, planes, factions, cards, and mechanics as terms unless the same person has a direct profile. Story prose controls plot/identity claims; product, card-gallery, and mechanics pages control release, card, and rules claims only.
omissions: All Magic sets, planes, eras, novels, comics, games, and localized stories outside Wilds of Eldraine WOE and its five English episodes.
Named people and entities that occur only in card names, card art, short fiction, or unprofiled episode appearances, including Obyra, Ruby, the witch sisters, Imodane, Syr Ginger, and Tough Cookie.
Wilds of Eldraine Commander (WOC), Enchanting Tales (WOT), Arena-only release timing, and gameplay formats except where necessary to distinguish products or mechanics.
Player decks, tournament results, fan interpretations, and any claim inferred only from a card's color, type line, art, rules text, flavor text, or alternate treatment.
uncertainties: No official retcon notice affecting the selected August-September 2023 story witness was identified. Later Magic stories may continue, revise, or contextualize these characters, but are out of scope.
The English official story is the textual witness. Official product pages have localized versions, but this pass does not compare translations, localized naming, or localization-specific wording.

Card representation, named legendary cards, and mechanics are not complete biography or plot evidence; the same character may receive different game objects or treatments without creating a new narrative continuity.

The story includes war aftermath, bereavement, nightmares, manipulation, sleep/entrapment, violence, and fairy-tale horror. Its 'fae,' royalty, and witch imagery are fictional genre constructs and should not be mapped to living cultures or spiritual traditions without further evidence.
evidence_basis: Official Wizards of the Coast set, story, mechanics, and card-gallery pages only. Story pages are primary evidence for narrative events; official set material is used for release/product and rules boundaries.
